observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 30 stand in the left margin and the locator «p. 186.» (L15) in the right margin. In «p. 186.» the 6 is printed blotted.
body L13, L20: specks stand over the u of «cui», and over the S and the s of «Solis»; they are not accents.
body L20: the letter of the reference (d) is bold italic; it is printed broken, its bowl hardly visible.
body L33: the dot of the i of «[i. e.» did not print.
body L14: a speck stands in the right margin beside the line; it is not a sign.
notes_left L6: the letter of «adnot. d» is bold italic.
body L1, L6: specks stand over the m of «Ipsarum» and over the s of «constellationibus», the second a short slanting stroke like an acute accent; they are not accents.
body L3, L14: the o of «comparata» and the o of «corpus» are printed thin and broken.

body L8, L26, L29: specks stand at the foot of the last m of «maximum», at the foot of the m of «arcum» before «16°», and under the u of «subtendi»; they are not points. A speck stands over the e of «Lunae»; it is not an accent.
notes_left L8, L11: a speck stands under the 6 of «(6)»; in «248.» the 8 is printed broken, its upper loop open at the right, like R.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
